review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid redefining `downsize` with incompatible arity**

The second `downsize` definition overwrites the first one, so callers that pass `(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts)` now raise `ArgumentError` (e.g., `app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb` calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts)`). This change introduces a runtime failure path for emoji resizing and any other 4-arg uses. Consider keeping only one signature or delegating the 4-arg version to the dimensions form.

prs.title: FEATURE: per-topic unsubscribe option in emails

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard missing TopicUser when handling unsubscribe**

`TopicUser.find_by` can return `nil` (e.g., for a user who receives a notification but does not yet have a `topic_users` row, or if `current_user` is nil due to a logged-out unsubscribe link), and the next line calls `tu.notification_level`, which will raise `NoMethodError`. That makes the unsubscribe endpoint crash for those users instead of toggling the state. Consider creating the record (or bailing out) when `tu` is nil before accessing `notification_level`.

prs.title: Add comprehensive email validation for blocked users

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize blocked email lookups to avoid case bypass**

BlockedEmail lookups are currently case-sensitive (`where(email: email)`), so a blocked address stored as `bad@spam.com` will not match user input like `Bad@spam.com`. Discourse already normalizes emails elsewhere (e.g., login uses `Email.downcase`), so users can bypass the block by changing case. Consider normalizing the input (and/or stored values) with `Email.downcase` before querying so blocked emails are enforced consistently.

prs.title: Enhance embed URL handling and validation system

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use a valid postMessage target origin**

If the embedding page’s referer includes a path or query (which is the normal case), passing the full URL to `postMessage` makes the targetOrigin invalid in browsers. That causes the resize message to throw/ignore and the iframe never resizes. Use the origin portion (scheme + host + port) or `"*"` instead of the full referer so resize works for typical embed URLs.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard against feeds without content fields**

Some RSS/Atom feeds omit `content` and only provide `description` or `summary`. Calling `i.content.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError` on those feeds, which aborts the poll job and prevents any topics from being imported/updated. Consider falling back to another field or an empty string before calling `scrub`.

**<sub><sub>![P3 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P3-lightgrey?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep light-theme helper color unchanged**

In light themes `dark-light-choose` returns its first argument (see `common/foundation/variables.scss`), so this change makes the light-theme `.custom-message-length` text use `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` instead of the previous 70%. That noticeably darkens the helper text in light mode, which looks like an accidental regression given the commit intent to adjust dark-theme colors only; consider keeping the first argument at 70% and only shifting the dark-theme value to `$secondary`.

prs.title: FIX: proper handling of group memberships

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use ceiling when computing total pages**

`totalPages` currently returns `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which over-counts when the total is an exact multiple of the page size (e.g., 100 users with limit 50 yields 3 pages). Because `showingLast` is derived from this value, the “next” action allows navigating to a final empty page and `findMembers` will request an offset with no results. Using `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` (or `Math.floor((user_count - 1) / limit) + 1`) prevents the extra blank page.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include parent-locale fallback before default locale**

This custom fallback list skips the parent locale (e.g., `fr` for `fr_CA`), so lookups that were previously satisfied by a base language will now jump straight to the site default or `:en`. That means users on region-specific locales can see missing/English strings even when a base locale translation exists. This regression happens specifically for locales with regional variants where only the base locale has a translation.

prs.title: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize migrated hosts to avoid breaking existing embeds**

The migration inserts the raw `embeddable_hosts` setting value directly into `embeddable_hosts.host`. If the existing setting contains entries like `http://example.com` or `example.com/path` (both allowed previously), those strings are persisted verbatim. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` later compares `uri.host` (e.g., `example.com`) to the stored value, so these migrated rows will never match and previously allowed embeds will be rejected. This is a regression for any install that used URLs or paths in the old setting; the migration should strip scheme/path before inserting.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard against nil host during validation**

The `before_validation` hook unconditionally calls `sub!` on `self.host`. If a client submits a blank or missing host (e.g., malformed API usage or bypassing the UI guard), `self.host` will be `nil` and this hook raises `NoMethodError`, returning 500 instead of a validation error. Adding a presence check (or using safe navigation) would preserve the intended validation flow.
